messages:
Sam (People Ops): Thanks for the Qs during the all-hands segment on hybrid/office ops — threading answers here. Ask follow-ups below.
Taylor (Eng): Are we changing the "recommended in-office days" policy or leaving it to teams? Some of us rely on overlaps for design reviews.
Sam (People Ops): Policy stays "team-defined with recommended 2 days". Teams should document their expected overlap in the team page. We'll provide a short template.
Zoe (Customer Success): For customer-facing folks who travel frequently, can they book a desk same-day when in town?
Renee (Facilities): Yes — use /hoteling and choose the "business travel" tag; same-day bookings allowed but priority goes to booked business travel desks.
Taylor (Eng): For quarterly offsites, is the company covering travel and lodging for attendees? What about partners who join?
Arjun (CEO): Company covers travel + hotel for Redwood employees invited to quarterly offsites. Partners are treated as client/partner expenses — coordinate with Finance.
Zoe (Customer Success): Is there a meal cap for offsite days?
travel-bot: Offsite meal guidance: $65/day domestic, $95/day international. Internal offsite meals billed to team offsite budget; partner meals billed as client entertainment.
Taylor (Eng): If someone books a non-refundable fare to save cost, do they need extra approvals?
Sam (People Ops): If >$400 or non-refundable, get manager + People Ops approval via the travel form: https://intranet.redwood/forms/travel. Include reason in notes.
Renee (Facilities): Quick announce: starting June 1 we'll support half-day hoteling blocks to reduce no-shows. Details to follow.
Zoe (Customer Success): Are coworking passes ok to expense when traveling for focused work?
travel-bot: Coworking reimbursable with manager pre-approval up to $45/day. Tag as "coworking" in Expensify.
Taylor (Eng): Will managers be nudged to publish team schedules? We need that to plan sprints.
Sam (People Ops): Yes — automated reminders to managers on May 10. We'll publish a checklist and example schedules before then.
Arjun (CEO): One more note: leaders should balance team autonomy with predictable overlap for cross-team work. If a project needs regular co-location, flag it during planning and we'll budget for it.
Sam (People Ops): Action items recap: 1) People Ops to post schedule template and checklist by May 5; 2) Facilities to enable "business travel" hoteling tag + half-day slots by June 1; 3) Finance to confirm per-diem and coworking categories in Expensify by Apr 28. I'll update this thread when items are live.
Taylor (Eng): Thanks, that's helpful.
Zoe (Customer Success): Appreciated!
Sam (People Ops): Drop any edge cases here or DM me. :pray:
